# Castle Packaging

> Castle Packaging is a Bengaluru-based manufacturer of sustainable paper packaging: kraft, recycled and virgin paper bags, V-bottom paper covers (without handles) for bakeries and grocery stores, paper cups, and paper tissues. Every product is available with custom printing and is made in-house — Castle Packaging is a direct manufacturer, not a reseller.

## Company

- Name: Castle Packaging
- Location: No. 11, Pipe Line Road, Balaji Layout, Kempapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560090, India
- Phone: +91 96115 35171
- Email: info@castlepkg.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919611535171

## Products

- Paper Bags — kraft, recycled and virgin paper, custom sizes and printing, for retail, food and gifting.
- Paper Covers — V-bottom kraft paper covers without handles, sold by weight (per kg), for bakeries, pharmacies and grocery stores.
- Paper Cups — food-safe paper cups in multiple sizes, for cafes, events and food service.
- Paper Tissues — hard, semi soft, soft and virgin cellulose fibre grades, for HORECA, retail and institutional use.
- Custom Printing — logo and branding printed on any of the above products.
